articles.title: Petrol, Diesel Export Duties Raised As Centre Revises Windfall Tax Rates For Fortnight
articles.description: The Centre has increased the windfall gains tax on exported petrol and diesel while marginally reducing the levy on aviation turbine fuel (ATF). Effective September 1, diesel export duty rises to ₹25 per litre, petrol to ₹1.5 per litre, while ATF duty drops to ₹19 per litre.
